verdict.rationale: Meltano's marketing docs mention 'Built-in pipeline monitoring and alerts' but there is no detail on table-level freshness metrics, SLA/cadence tracking, or alerting mechanisms for missed runs; scheduling is delegated to Airflow (external orchestrator) rather than a native freshness dashboard. missing for 10: table-level freshness dashboard, explicit cadence/SLA definition and breach alerting, first-party or community evidence of this working in practice.
